subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should the remaining durable-approval work be repaired in this aggregate after removing already-landed native overlap, or moved into focused current-main PRs?
rationale: The branch contains valuable unique work but conflicts in central authorization and session-state paths while a large native component has already landed, so the intended landing shape determines the safest conflict-resolution and proof strategy.

options.title: Repair the aggregate
options.body: Resolve the central conflicts, remove redundant mobile overlap, preserve compatibility contracts, and validate the complete exact head.

options.title: Split residual changes
options.body: Move the unique session propagation, fail-closed gate, and repository gate-repair deltas into smaller current-main PRs.

recommendation.title: Repair the aggregate
recommendation.body: Resolve the central conflicts, remove redundant mobile overlap, preserve compatibility contracts, and validate the complete exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the integration and its current-main component history and is the strongest evidence-backed owner of the landing-shape decision.
